t: This is Blackheath Quaker Meeting House, a Grade II listed building in the London Borough of Lewisham. Look at the raw concrete, because it's believed to be the only Quaker meeting house in Britain built in the Brutalist style. It was designed by Trevor Dannatt, who lived to the age of 100. A survey for Historic England and Quakers in Britain called it a Brutalist jewel of exceptional aesthetic value. Blackheath Quakers have met here since 1972, and many community groups use it too.
